note: What each feature needs from the llama.cpp engine build. minBuild is a llama.cpp release number (b11669 is 11669): a build older than that cannot serve the feature. unsupportedBackends maps a build id (vulkan, metal, cuda-12, ...) to the reason that backend cannot serve it at all. The floors are deliberately conservative (a little after the feature landed in llama-server) and are reviewed whenever the catalog pin moves; a custom build of unknown number is trusted.
